experiments.name: Volatility gate challenger
experiments.hypothesis: A separately versioned volatility-aware challenger may improve benchmark-relative drawdown without sacrificing robust excess CAGR.
experiments.reason: Research evidence is not authorization for promotion

experiments.name: Trend breadth challenger
experiments.hypothesis: A separately versioned breadth confirmation layer may reduce false risk-on transitions while preserving long-run excess return.
experiments.reason: Survivorship-safe point-in-time breadth constituent history is not yet repository evidence.

experiments.name: Stress-only volatility intervention
experiments.hypothesis: Restricting volatility intervention to lagged high-volatility stress may retain the observed stress-regime drawdown benefit without paying the normal-regime performance penalty.
experiments.reason: Research evidence is not authorization for promotion

experiments.name: Stress + trend confirmation
experiments.hypothesis: Capping exposure only when lagged realized volatility is high and QQQ is below its lagged SMA200 may preserve crisis drawdown protection while avoiding unnecessary intervention in high-volatility uptrends.
experiments.reason: Research evidence is not authorization for promotion

experiments.name: Lagged drawdown circuit breaker
experiments.hypothesis: A separately versioned lagged drawdown-state circuit breaker may reduce severe path risk by capping exposure only after QQQ is at least 15% below its prior 252-session high, without using volatility thresholds or breadth data.
experiments.reason: Research evidence is not authorization for promotion

experiments.name: Momentum acceleration overlay
experiments.hypothesis: A small additive exposure overlay during unusually strong persistent QQQ momentum may improve excess return without relying on prior risk-off mechanisms.
experiments.reason: Research evidence is not authorization for promotion

experiments.name: Asymmetric upshift confirmation
experiments.hypothesis: One extra completed-session confirmation before frozen-8.0 exposure increases may reduce whipsaw drawdown with limited CAGR drag while reductions remain immediate.
experiments.reason: Research evidence is not authorization for promotion
